xwikidoc.content: {{velocity output="false"}} ## Shared setup. Defines: $sbEnabled, $sbMissingText, $sbFields, $sbLabels, $sbOptions, $sbExcluded, $sbClassName. #set ($sbClassName = 'SensitivityBanner.Code.SensitivityClass') #set ($sbConfigObj = $xwiki.getDocument('SensitivityBanner.Code.Admin').getObject('SensitivityBanner.Code.ConfigClass')) #set ($sbDefaults = { 'missingText': 'Page missing sensitivity', 'owner': "Management Senior Management Standard Staff", 'security': "Sensitive|#c0392b Open|#2e7d32", 'country': "UK Europe", 'excluded': "XWiki SensitivityBanner AppWithinMinutes" }) ## Enabled by default: only an explicit saved 0 disables it. #set ($sbEnabled = true) #if ($sbConfigObj) #set ($sbEnabledValue = $sbConfigObj.getValue('enabled')) #if ("$!sbEnabledValue" == '0') #set ($sbEnabled = false) #end #end #macro (sbConfigValue $prop $default) #set ($sbOut = $default) #if ($sbConfigObj) #set ($sbTmp = "$!sbConfigObj.getValue($prop)") #if ($sbTmp.trim() != '') #set ($sbOut = $sbTmp) #end #end #end #sbConfigValue('missingText' $sbDefaults.missingText) #set ($sbMissingText = $sbOut) #set ($sbFields = ['owner', 'security', 'country']) #set ($sbLabels = {'owner': 'Owner', 'security': 'Security', 'country': 'Country'}) #set ($sbPropNames = {'owner': 'ownerValues', 'security': 'securityValues', 'country': 'countryValues'}) #set ($sbOptions = {}) #foreach ($sbField in $sbFields) #sbConfigValue($sbPropNames.get($sbField) $sbDefaults.get($sbField)) #set ($sbList = []) #foreach ($sbLine in $sbOut.split('\r?\n')) #set ($sbLine = $sbLine.trim()) #if ($sbLine != '') #set ($sbParts = $sbLine.split('\|', 2)) #set ($sbLabel = $sbParts[0].trim()) #set ($sbColour = '') #if ($sbParts.size() > 1 && $sbParts[1].trim().matches('^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$')) #set ($sbColour = $sbParts[1].trim()) #end #set ($discard = $sbList.add({'label': $sbLabel, 'colour': $sbColour})) #end #end #set ($discard = $sbOptions.put($sbField, $sbList)) #end #sbConfigValue('excludedSpaces' $sbDefaults.excluded) #set ($sbExcludedList = []) #foreach ($sbLine in $sbOut.split('\r?\n')) #if ($sbLine.trim() != '') #set ($discard = $sbExcludedList.add($sbLine.trim())) #end #end #set ($sbExcluded = false) #if ($doc && $doc.documentReference) #set ($sbTopSpace = $doc.documentReference.spaceReferences.get(0).name) #if ($sbExcludedList.contains($sbTopSpace)) #set ($sbExcluded = true) #end #end ## Terminal pages and Application Within Minutes application pages. On unless explicitly saved as 0. #set ($sbExcludeTerminal = true) #set ($sbExcludeApps = true) #if ($sbConfigObj) #if ("$!sbConfigObj.getValue('excludeTerminal')" == '0') #set ($sbExcludeTerminal = false) #end #if ("$!sbConfigObj.getValue('excludeApps')" == '0') #set ($sbExcludeApps = false) #end #end #if ($doc && $doc.documentReference) ## A terminal page is any page not named WebHome (the default home page name). #if ($sbExcludeTerminal && $doc.documentReference.name != 'WebHome') #set ($sbExcluded = true) #end ## Application Within Minutes application home pages carry an AppWithinMinutes.LiveTableClass object. #if ($sbExcludeApps && $doc.getObject('AppWithinMinutes.LiveTableClass')) #set ($sbExcluded = true) #end #end ## A page that already has a value keeps its banner even if it would otherwise be excluded. #set ($sbHasValue = false) #set ($sbCheckObj = $doc.getObject($sbClassName)) #if ($sbCheckObj) #foreach ($sbCheckField in $sbFields) #set ($sbCheckValue = "$!sbCheckObj.getValue($sbCheckField)") #if ($sbCheckValue.trim() != '') #set ($sbHasValue = true) #end #end #end ## Finds the newest earlier version of a page that had sensitivity values. ## Sets $sbHist (map field to value, empty map if none) and $sbHistRev (version, empty if none). #macro (sbFindHistory $sbHistTarget) #set ($sbHist = {}) #set ($sbHistRev = '') #foreach ($sbRev in $sbHistTarget.getRecentRevisions(30)) #if ($sbHist.isEmpty()) #set ($sbOldDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($sbHistTarget, $sbRev)) #set ($sbOldObjs = $sbOldDoc.getObjects($sbClassName)) #if (!$sbOldObjs.isEmpty()) #set ($sbTmpHist = {}) #set ($sbAnyHist = false) #foreach ($sbHistField in $sbFields) #set ($sbHistValue = "$!sbOldObjs.get(0).getValue($sbHistField)") #set ($sbHistValue = $sbHistValue.trim()) #set ($discard = $sbTmpHist.put($sbHistField, $sbHistValue)) #if ($sbHistValue != '') #set ($sbAnyHist = true) #end #end #if ($sbAnyHist) #set ($sbHist = $sbTmpHist) #set ($sbHistRev = $sbRev) #end #end #end #end #end {{/velocity}}
